note: Rule texts are summarised from the cited official or chamber pages. Rules change between years and differ by state. Check with the Landwirtschaftsamt before relying on any result.

gloez7.enforcement_note: Applies to farms with more than 10 ha arable land. Organic farms and some grassland/legume-dominated farms are exempt. Farmily does not know the farm exemptions, so the rule is applied as a hard filter and the farmer is told to check exemptions.

source.name: Landwirtschaftskammer NRW: Einhaltung des Fruchtwechsels (GLÖZ 7) im Rahmen der Konditionalität, status 10.09.2025, planning year 2026

eco_scheme_or2.label_en: Eco-scheme ÖR 2: diverse crops in arable farming
eco_scheme_or2.premium_note: The payment rate changes by year. It is not shown because no current rate was verified.

source.name: MLEUV Brandenburg: Öko-Regelungen (ÖR 2: Anbau vielfältiger Kulturen mit mindestens fünf Hauptfruchtarten im Ackerbau einschließlich des Anbaus von Leguminosen mit einem Mindestanteil von 10 Prozent)

duev.yield_difference_basis: Average yield of the last five years on the farm. Unknown here, so no yield correction is applied unless the farmer enters it.
duev.red_area_note: Nitrate-vulnerable ('rote') areas require a further 20 % reduction under DüV §13a. The area status is not known to Farmily and is not applied.
duev.nmin_note: Nmin (0-90 cm, at start of vegetation) must be measured or taken from the state's Nmin service. Farmily cannot estimate it.
